column3: Saori Route · Meeting at Akibahara
Now now, no need to hold back, a-a-accept it!
Please accept this offering!
This doesn't make any sense!
Hoho!?
You honestly still fail to grasp the meaning of why I'm handing over this present...
Are you an idiot?!
Is Kyousuke-shi really saying such a thing?
That's exactly what I've been saying.
Then, while this is presumptuous, do allow me to include an explanation.
Birthdays, anniversaries, ceremonies, celebrations, etc... It's common to give presents during such events.
What Saori said does make some sense.
During events in galge, whether you have given the right presents to your target determines if you'll reach the true ending.
But, I believe that...
Wanting to give a present from the heart requires no reason!
Eh, ah...
Fufu.
It seems Kyousuke-shi is speechless under the pressure of my impact.
I was just surprised because it's too sudden!
It's just a joke, right? I can tell that it's a plot to get a laugh out of my reaction.
What are you saying, Kyousuke-shi! I'm being very serious, you know?
In any case, I won't accept. Absolutely, absolutely won't!
Don't say such a thing...
These things are akin to my soul... By all means, I want you to accept them!
How can I accept your soul!?
Ku... it's not working even after saying this much!?
Of course not.
Please treasure such important things properly, okay?
Uuu... I'm grateful that you understand the value of my soul.
But that's precisely why I want you to have it!
Eh... er... well...
Stop hesitating and just accept it...
Come on now... accept it quickly and you'll feel all better!
Why do you sound like a policeman pressing a suspect for a confession!?
If you don't accept it...
Then I shall be resolute in committing seppuku!
Se-Seppuku!? Hold on! Please tell me the reason first!
Oh! You at last are willing to listen to me?
It's suddenly turning into a dangerous development!
And talking about seppuku in this day and age...
I am dead serious about it.
To prove that...
Seppuku is a little exaggerated, isn't it...
In this damned peaceful period, this kind of speech lacks persuasiveness...
When I was but a child, I mastered the art of seppuku.
Starting from the appendix, make a lateral incision to the right of the abdomen!
You'll cut through your appendix! You'd rather die?!
Well, it's just a joke.
A joke!?
What a tiring fellow...!
Ah! I've deceived an innocent townsperson yet again...!
Suicide assistant! Come forth, suicide assistant!
R-R-R-Relax, Saori!
The store assistant is about to call the police.
If Kyousuke-shi were to accept it beforehand, then everything would be settled.
I'm in your care, Kyousuke-shi.
I'm not sure what to say...
Oh come on, it's sad if you don't play along with the joke.
Was that appendicitis all a joke?!
That's it Kyousuke-shi! You're on now!
...Ugh!
I'm not playing along!
Huh! No no no!
If I say I'll do it, I'll honestly do so, you know...?
Stop shouting about committing seppuku!
Tch!
W-What...?
Very well, if you won't let me cut it, I'll mince it.
Huuh?
Incidentally, I have some great tips.
There's a butcher shop selling awesome sandwiches near Manseibashi.
Since we came to Akibahara, let's try it out!
Not saying anything? Can't say anything?
Hey... Kyousuke-shi...
If you don't quickly accept it, I'll slash my guts open for real...?
I won't play along with your "I'll cut myself" scam.
You still don't grasp my earnestness... Kuh!
